scope: Generated audio and synthetic log demonstration; not industrial fault accuracy

audio.confidence_semantics: 1.0 is an adapter acceptance marker, not fault probability
limitations: Generated demo tones are not real machine recordings.
Mic placement, gain, background noise and operating load affect scores.
Fixed nonoverlapping windows; independent recordings reset persistence.
Acoustic deviation is not a diagnosis.

metrics.scope: Generated harmonics and injected spectral changes; not real machinery accuracy
metrics.matching: Whole one-second window inside labelled deviation interval
metrics.note: Synthetic point-window evaluation; not cause classification or factory accuracy.

fusion.note: Cooccurrence is not causality; mixed real and synthetic sources are composed replay.
